newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end firm, led by brewer Bavaria.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end firm, led by brewer Bavaria.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed up led by brewing giant Bavaria as volumes dropped back from high levels seen during the week.
Bogota's IBB index closed up 1.07 percent at 1,091.74 amid a 785 million pesos trade, while Medellin's IBOMED index was up 0.74 percent to 16,796.64 amid a 2.1 billion pesos volume.
Bavaria, head of the Santo Domingo industrial conglomerate, rose 4.78 percent to a new historic high of 7,649 in Bogota and 4.92 percent to 7,680 in Medellin.
